_comment: One source of truth for week 10's rubric. The grader scores from this file, the homework's grading table is copied from it, and the Canvas rubric is generated from it. `suite` says which test run scores an item — 'checks' is `dotnet test Project.Checks` (canonical, replaced wholesale by the grader), 'tests' is `dotnet test Project.Tests` (the student's OWN suite, run as-is and never replaced). The dictated student fact carries the WEEK rather than a check number — Week10_ASecondSaveChangesTheRow — and it is the lab's Task 5 fact on the student's own registry. Checks 1 to 5 are the homework's Tasks 1 to 5; check 1 is the came-forward check and is green before the student starts. ⚠️ THE RUN-IT ITEM IS A BUILD-IT ITEM FROM THIS WEEK ON, AND IT IS NOT A SOFTENING: the program's data lives in a database now, so running it needs the student's connection string, which is in their secret store and — correctly — not in the repo. `dotnet run` on a clone cannot work for anybody. What a clone still proves is that it COMPILES. Their code is still executed by both suites. Weeks 11-13 inherit this. The graded repo is the PROJECT repo (D1b); the coursework repo is not cloned.

Check1_WeeksFourToNineStillHold.label: Weeks 4-9 still hold — Topic, no public fields, All() copies, Find and Remove behave, IListed kept by record and registry, Everything() intact, Add refuses a duplicate, and Names/Sorted/Matching still answer

Check2_TheRecordIsShapedForATable.label: Your record has an Id the database can tell its rows apart by, its name is stored, and ProjectContext has a table for it

Check3_ThereIsAMigration.label: A migration exists in your project — you ran `dotnet ef migrations add` rather than making the table by hand

Check4_TheRegistrySurvivesARestart.label: Save and Load round-trip every record and what it keeps — and an empty table leaves a seeded registry alone

Check5_ASecondSaveChangesTheRow.label: A record that came out of the table and is saved again changes its row instead of adding a second one

Week10_ASecondSaveChangesTheRow.label: Your test: a record loaded, changed and saved again is still one row, with the change on it — written by you, before the fix, green in your own suite

repoReachable.label: Public project repo exists at the URL you submitted, and clones

programBuilds.label: The project compiles from a clean clone — from this week it cannot be RUN anywhere but your own machine, because your connection string is not in the repo

gitignoreClean.label: bin/ and obj/ tracked nowhere in the project repo — the .gitignore holding

commits.label: 3+ commits on THIS week's branch 👀 (meaningful messages are a judgment call)

mergedPr.label: A merge commit on main — this week's branch → pull request → merge
